design.question: What is the Minimum Failure Set — smallest subset of blocks that keeps the explore-agent bomb firing?
design.baseline_configuration: only-cr-imp: CR imperative, all other procedural blocks declarative
design.protected_rationale: CR removal trivially defuses the bomb; EA_TARGET_BLOCK removal is a measurement confound (the probe scores whether the model recommends the Explore agent, but without the policy block present the model was never told of it).
